executive_summary.critical_finding: Pattern trigger conditions are excessively restrictive, causing 99.9% trade rejection rate

patterns_identified.name: Universal trigger_match failure
patterns_identified.description: All pattern trigger checks fail despite patterns meeting confidence threshold (meets_trigger=True)

patterns_identified.name: 100% Lateral regime detection
patterns_identified.evidence: All 10 pairs show regime_distribution: {lateral: 100.0, bull: 0, bear: 0, transition: 0}
patterns_identified.description: Regime validator classifies all market conditions as LATERAL, preventing breakout/breakdown patterns from ever triggering

patterns_identified.name: Range tolerance mismatch
patterns_identified.evidence: trading_bot.py uses range_tolerance=0.025 (2.5%) but pattern DB uses 0.01 (1%)
patterns_identified.description: Component inconsistency causes unexpected behavior in range trading logic

patterns_identified.name: Axiom A6 violation - Unusual gap
patterns_identified.description: Price gap exceeded 5-sigma threshold, indicating data anomaly or extreme market event

primary_cause.name: Excessively restrictive range trigger conditions
primary_cause.description: Pattern definitions require price to be within 1% of range extreme AND range width < 3%
primary_cause.impact: 99.9% of potential trades rejected at trigger check

secondary_causes.name: Regime detection thresholds too conservative for crypto
secondary_causes.description: z_score_threshold=0.02 and volatility_threshold=0.03 are too tight for crypto market dynamics
secondary_causes.impact: All markets classified as LATERAL, no trend-following opportunities

secondary_causes.name: Component tolerance inconsistency
secondary_causes.description: Trading bot and pattern database use different range_tolerance values

H1_direction_invertida.evidence: direction_analysis from 1B.3 showed range_sell_high had correct direction (100%) but still lost
H1_direction_invertida.conclusion: Direction is not the primary issue

H2_range_miscalculation.evidence: 1B.3 analysis showed range_buy_low entries at 2.55-3.27% deviation (outside 1% tolerance)
H2_range_miscalculation.conclusion: Range calculation timing contributes but is not sole cause

H4_tp_sl_too_tight.evidence: 1B.3 testing showed TP/SL were not the limiting factor

H5_trigger_conditions_too_restrictive.conclusion: PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE - triggers reject 99.9% of opportunities

new_hypothesis: H5: Pattern trigger conditions are mathematically incompatible with typical crypto price action - requiring simultaneous occurrence of (a) range width <3% AND (b) price within 1% of extreme creates near-impossible entry conditions
evidence_supporting_h5: Mathematical analysis: For a 3% range, 1% tolerance at extremes = only 0.6% of price range triggers entry
Empirical: 7773 failed triggers vs 7 executed trades = 0.09% success rate
Comparison: 1B.3 direction analysis showed entries at 2.5-3.3% deviation - outside 1% tolerance but would be valid with 2.5% tolerance
All pairs 100% lateral = regime detection not providing variety in pattern types

immediate_actions.action: Increase range_tolerance in pattern definitions from 0.01 to 0.025
immediate_actions.rationale: Align with trading_bot.py setting and allow more realistic entry points
Allow trading in moderately volatile lateral markets (up to 5% range)

immediate_actions.action: Relax regime detection thresholds for crypto markets
immediate_actions.rationale: Better capture bull/bear regimes in crypto volatility environment

validation_steps: Verify trigger_match=True occurs with reasonable frequency
Check CA passing increases from 3/8 to ≥4/8

axiom_violations_detail.recommendation: Review data quality for gaps >10%, consider gap filter in entry logic

delta.improvement: Direction filter helped but trigger conditions remain blocking factor
